phase_keywords: For each product collected in phase 1 (ranks 25-35), visit its detail page and extract reviews, pros & cons, and Q&A details.

After collecting all detail data for all products, return the combined results. If a detail page does not have reviews/pros-cons/QA sections, note them as empty/absent with evidence.

phase_keywords: Navigate to the trending/week page, identify product cards by DOM structure (not badge text), determine their positional rank by DOM order, and extract product name and detail URL for positions 25-35.

1. Navigate to https://theresanaiforthat.com/trending/week/
2. Use Page.getState and DOM.getAXTree to understand the product card structure.
3. Identify how individual product cards are structured. Each card should have a product name (likely a heading or link) and a link to the detail page (href matching /ai/product-name/). Ignore comment links (/comment/ in URL).
4. Products are ranked implicitly by their DOM/appearance order. The first product card is rank 1, second is rank 2, etc.
5. Count product cards in DOM order. Scroll down progressively to materialize all cards through at least position 35.
6. For product cards at positions 25 through 35 (inclusive), extract:
   - rank: the positional number (25-35, based on DOM order of product cards)
   - productName: the tool name from the card
   - detailUrl: the href to the product detail page (must match /ai/product-name/ pattern, NOT /comment/)
7. Use DOM.getAXTree to locate cards, DOM.getText for names, DOM.getAttribute for hrefs.
8. Save all 11 rows with record_extraction fields: rank, productName, detailUrl.
9. Mark rank provenance: include rankEvidenceText explaining 'Position N in DOM card order on trending/week page'.
